verses: Haa Meem
Uss kitab ka nazil farmana uss Allah ki taraf say hai jo ghalib aur dana hai
Gunah ka bakhshney wala aur tauba ka qabool farmaney wala sakht azab wala inam o qudrat wala, jiss kay siwa koi mabood nahi. Ussi ki taraf wapis lotna hai
Allah Taalaa ki aayaton mein o hi log jhagartay hain jo kafir hain pus unn logon ka shehron mein chalna phirna aap ko dhokay mein na dalay

Qom Nooh ney aur unn kay baad kay girohon ney bhi jhutlaya tha. Aur her ummat ney apney rasool ko giriftar ker lenay ka iradah kiya aur baatil kay zariye kajj behasiyan kin, takay unn say haq ko bigar den pus mein ney unn ko pakar liya, so meri taraf say kaisi saza hui
Aur ussi tarah aap kay rab ka hukum kafiron per sabit ho gaya kay woh dozakhi hain

Arsh kay uthaney walay aur uss kay aas pass kay (farishtay) apney rab ki tasbeeh hamd kay sath sath kertay hain aur uss per eman rakhtay hain aur eman walon kay liye istaghfaar kertay hain, kehtay hain kay aey humaray perwerdigar! tu ney her cheez ko apni bakhsish aur ilm say gher rakha hai, pus to unhen bakhsh dey jo tauba keren aur teri raah ki pairwee keren aur to unhen dozakh kay azab say bhi bacha ley

Aey humaray rab! to unhen hameshgi wali jannaton mein ley jaa jin ka tu ney unn say wada kiya hai aur unn kay baap dadon aur biwiyon aur aulad mein say (bhi) unn (sab) ko jo nek amal hain. Yaqeenan to to ghalib o ba-hikmat hai
Unhen buraiyon say bhi mehfooz rakh, haq to yeh hai kay uss din tu ney jissay buraiyon say bacha liya uss per tu ney rehmat ker di aur boht bari kaamyabi to yehi hai

Be-shak jin logon ney kufur kiya unhen yeh awaz di jaye gi kay yaqeenan Allah ka tum per ghussa hona say boht ziyadah hai jo tum ghussa hotay thay apney ji say, jab tum eman ki taraf bulaye jatay thay phir kufur kerney lagtay thay
Woh kahen gay aey humaray perwerdigar! tu ney humen doobara maara aur do baar hi jalaya, abb hum apney gunahon kay iqrari hain, to kiya abb koi raah nikalney ki bhi hai?

Yeh (azab) tumhen uss liye hai kay jab sirf akelay Allah ka zikar kiya jata to tum inkar ker jatay thay aur agar uss kay sath kissi ko shareek kiya jata tha to tum maan letay thay pus abb faisla Allah buland o buzurg hi ka hai
O hi hai jo tumhen apni nishaniyan dikhlata hai aur tumharay aasman say rozi utarta hai, naseehat to sirf o hi hasil kertay hain jo (Allah ki taraf) rujoo kertay hain
Tum Allah ko pukartay raho uss kay liye deen ko khalis ker kay go kafir bura manen
Buland darjon wala arsh malik woh apney bandon mein say jiss per chahata hai wahee nazil farmata hai, takay woh mulaqat kay din say daraye
Jiss din sab log zahir ho jayen gay, unn ki koi cheez Allah say posheedah na rahey gi. Aaj kiss ki badshahi hai? Faqat Allah wahid o wahid-o-qahar ki
Aaj her nafs ko uss ki kamaee ka badla diya jaye ga. Aaj (kissi qasam ka) zulm nahi, yaqeenan Allah Taalaa boht jald hisab kerney wala hai

Aur unhen boht hi qareeb aaney wali (qayamat say) aagah ker dijiye, jab kay dil halaq tak phonch jayen gay aur sab khamosh hun gay, zalimon ka na koi dili dost hoga na sifarshi, kay jiss ki baat mani jaye gi
Woh aankhon ki khayanat ko aur seenon ki posheedah baaton ko (khoob) janta hai
Aur Allah Taalaa theek theek faisla ker dey ga uss kay siwa jinhen yeh log pukartay hain woh kissi cheez ka bhi faisla nahi saktay, be-shak Allah Taalaa khoob sunta khoob dekhta hai

Kiya yeh log zamin mein chalay phiray nahi kay dekhtay kay jo log unn say pehlay thay unn ka nateeja kaisa kuch hua? Woh ba-aetbaar qooat o taqat kay aur ba-aetbaar zamin mein apni yaadgaron kay unn say boht ziyadah thay, pus Allah ney unhen unn kay gunahon per pakar liya aur koi na hua jo unhen Allah kay azab say bacha leta
Yeh uss wajah say kay unn kay pass unn kay payghumbar moajzzay ley ley ker thay to woh inkar ker detay thay, pus Allah unhen pakar leta tha. Yaqeenan woh taqatwar aur sakht azab wala hai
Aur hum ney Musa (alaihi as-salam) ko apni aayaton aur khulli daleelon kay sath bheja
Firaun Haman aur Qaroon ki taraf to unhon ney kaha (yeh to) jadoogar aur jhoota hai

Pus jab unn kay pass (Musa alaihi as-salam) humari taraf say (deen) haq ko ley ker aaye unhon ney kaha kay uss kay sath eman walay hain unn kay larkon ko to maar dalo aur unn ki larkiyon ko zindah rakho aur kafiron ki jo heela saazi hai woh ghalati mein hi hai

Aur Firaun ney kaha mujhay chor do kay mein Musa (alaihi as-salam) ko maar dalon aur ussay chahaiye kay apney rab ko pukaray, mujhay to darr hai kay yeh kahen tumhara deen na badal dalay ya mulk mein koi (boht bara) fasad barpa na kerdey
Musa (alaihi as-salam) ney kaha mein apney aur tumharay rab ki panah mein aata hun her uss takabbur kerney walay shakhs (ki buraee) say jo roz hisab per eman nahi rakhta

Aur aik momin shakhs ney, jo Firaun kay khandan mein say tha aur apna eman chupaye huye tha, kaha kay kiya tum aik shakhs ko mehaz uss baat per qatal kertay ho kay woh kehta hai mera rab Allah hai aur tumharay rab ki taraf say daleelen ley ker aaya hai, agar woh jhoota ho to uss ka jhoot ussi per hai aur agar woh sacha ho, to jiss (azab) ka woh tum say wada ker raha hai uss mein say kuch na kuch to tum per aa paray ga, Allah Taalaa uss ki rehbari nahi kerta jo hadd say guzar janey walay aur jhootay hain

Aey meri qom kay logo! aaj to badshahat tumhari hai kay uss zamin per tum ghalib ho lekin agar Allah ka azab hum per aa gaya to kaun humari madad keray ga? Firaun bola, mein to tumhen o hi raye dey raha hun jo khud dekh raha hun aur mein to tumhen bhalaee ki raah hi batla raha hun
Uss momin ney kaha aey meri qom! (kay logo) mujhay to andesha hai kay tum per bhi wesa hi roz (bad azab) na aaye jo aur ummaton per aaya
Jaisay ummat Nooh aur aad o samood aur unn kay baad walon ka (haal hua), Allah apney bandon per kissi tarah ka zulm kerna nahi chahata
Aur mujhay tum per haank pukar kay din bhi darr hai
Jiss din tum peeth pher ker loto gay, tumhen Allah say bachaney wala koi na hoga aur jissay Allah gumrah ker dey uss ka hadi koi nahi

Aur uss say pehlay tumharay pass (hazrat) Yusuf daleelen ley ker aaye, phir bhi tum unn ki laee hui (daleel) mein shak o shuba)yeh hi kertay rahey yahan tak kay jab unn ki wafat ho gaee to kehney lagay unn kay baad to Allah kissi rasool ko bhejay ga hi nahi ussi tarah Allah gumrah kerta hai her uss shakhs ko jo hadd say barh janey wala shak o shuba)yeh kerney wala ho

Jo baghair kissi sanad kay jo unn kay pass aaee ho Allah ki aayaton mein jhagartay hain, Allah kay nazdeek aur mominon kay nazdeek yeh to boht bari narazgi ki cheez hai, Allah Taalaa ussi tarah her aik maghroor sirkash kay dil per mehar ker deta hai
Firaun ney kaha aey Haman! meray liye aik bala khana bana shayad kay mein aasman kay jo darwazay hain

(unn) darwazon tak phonch jaon aur Musa kay mabood ko jhank loon aur be-shak mein samjhta hun woh jhoota hai aur ussi tarah Firaun ki bad-kirdariyan ussay bhali dikhaee gaeen aur raah say rok diya gaya aur Firaun ki (her) heela saazi tabahi mein hi rahi
Aur uss momin shakhs ney kaha kay aey meri qom! (kay logo) tum (sab) meri pairwee kero mein nek raah ki taraf tumhari rehbari keroon ga
Aey meri qom! yeh hayat duniya mataa faani hai, (yaqeen mano kay qarar) aur hameshgi ka ghar to aakhirat hi hai

Jiss ney gunah kiya hai ussay to barabar barabar ka badla hi hai aur jiss ney neki ki hai khuwah woh mard ho ya aurat aur woh eman wala ho to yeh log jannat mein jayen gay aur o haan be-shumaar rozi payen gay
Aey meri qom! yeh kiya baat hai kay mein tumhen nijat ki taraf bula raha hun aur tum mujhay dozakh ki taraf bula rahey ho

Tum mujhay yeh dawat dey rahey ho kay mein Allah kay sath kufur keroon aur uss kay sath shirk keroon jiss ka koi ilm mujhay nahi aur mein tumhen ghalib bakhshney walay (mabood) ki taraf dawat dey raha hun

Yeh yaqeeni amar hai kay tum mujhay jiss ki taraf bula rahey ho woh to na duniya mein pukaray janey kay qabil hai na aakhirat mein, aur yeh (bhi yaqeeni baat hai) kay hum sab ka lotna Allah ki taraf hai aur hadd say guzar janey walay hi (yaqeenan) ahl dozakh hain
Pus aagay chal ker tum meri baaton ko yaad kero gay mein apna moamla Allah kay supurd kerta hun, yaqeenan Allah Taalaa bandon ka nigran hai
Pus ussay Allah Taalaa ney tamam badiyon say mehfooz rakh liya jo unhon ney soch rakhi thin aur Firaun walon per buri tarah ka azab ulat para
Aag hai jiss kay samney yeh her subha shaam laye jatay hain aur jiss din qayamat qaeem hogi (farman hoga kay) firaoniyon ko sakht tareen azab mein dalo

Aur jab kay dozakh mein aik doosray say jhagren gay to kamzor log takabbur walon say (jin kay yeh tabey thay) kahen gay kay hum to tumharay pairo thay to kiya abb tum hum say uss aag ka koi hissa hata saktay ho?
Woh baray log jawab den gay hum to sabhi uss aag mein hain, Allah Taalaa apney bandon kay darmiyan faislay ker chuka hai
Aur (tamam) jahannumi mill ker jahannum kay daroghon say kahen gay kay tum hi apney perwerdigar say dua kero kay woh kissi din to humaray azab mein kami kerdey

Woh jawab den gay kay kiya tumharay pass tumharay rasool moajzzay ley ker nahi aaye thay? Woh kahen gay kiyon nahi, woh kahen gay kay phir tum hi dua kero aur kafiron ki dua mehaz bey asar aur be-raah hai
Yaqeenan hum apney rasoolon ki aur eman walon ki madad zindagani duniya mein bhi keren gay aur uss din bhi jab gawahi denay walay kharay hun gay
Jiss din zalimon ko unn ki (uzur) maazrat kuch nafa na dey gi unn kay liye laanat hi hogi aur unn kay liye bura ghar ho ga
Hum ney Musa (alaihi as-salam) ko hidayat nama ata farmaya aur bano israeel ko uss kitab ka waris banaya
Kay woh hidayat o naseehat thi aqal mandon kay liye
Pus aey nabi! to sabar ker Allah ka wada bila-shak (o shuba)yeh) sacha hi hai to apney gunah ki moafi mangta reh aur subha shaam apney perwerdigar ki tasbeeh aur hamd biyan kerta reh

Jo log bawajood apney pass kissi sanad kay na honey kay aayaat elahi mein jhagra kertay hain unn kay dilon mein ba-juz niri baraee kay aur kuch nahi woh uss tak phonchney walay hi nahi, so to Allah ki panah mangta reh be-shak woh poora sunnay wala aur sab say ziyadah dekhney wala hai
Aasman o zamin ki pedaeesh yaqeenan insan ki pedaeesh say boht bara kaam hai, lekin (yeh aur baat hai kay) aksar log be-ilm hain
Andha aur beena barabar nahi na woh log jo eman laye aur bhalay kaam kiye badkaron kay (barabar hain), tum (boht) kum naseehat hasil ker rahey ho
Qayamat bil-yaqeen aur be-shuba aaney wali hai, lekin (yeh aur baat hai kay) boht say log eman nahi latay

Aur tumharay rab ka farman (sirzad chuka hai) kay mujh say dua kero mein tumhari duaon ko qabool keroon ga yaqeen mano kay jo log meri ibadat say khudsari kertay hain woh abhi abhi zaleel hoker jahannum mein phonch jayen gay

Allah Taalaa ney tumharay liye raat bana kay tum uss mein aaram hasil kero aur din ko dekhney wala bana diya, be-shak Allah Taalaa logon per fazal o karam wala hai lekin aksar log shukar guzari nahi kertay
Yehi Allah hai tum sab ka rab her cheez ka khaliq uss kay siwa koi mabood nahi phir kahan tum phiray jatay ho
Ussi tarah woh log bhi pheray jatay rahey jo Allah ki aayaton ka inkar kertay thay

Allah hi hai jiss ney tumharay liye zamin ko therney ki jagah aur aasman ko chat bana diya aur tumhari soorten banayen aur boht achi banayen aur tumhen umdah umdah cheezen khaney ko ata farmaeen, yehi Allah tumhara perwerdigar hai, pus boht hi barkaton wala Allah hai saray jahaan ka perwerish kerney wala
Woh zindah hai jiss kay siwa koi mabood nahi pus tum khalis uss ki ibadat kertay huye ussay pukaro, tamam khoobiyen Allah hi kay liye hain jo tamam jahano ka rab hai

Aap keh dijiye! kay mujhay unn ki ibadat say rok diya gaya hai jinhen tum Allah kay siwa pukar rahey ho uss bana per kay meray pass meray rab ki daleelen phonch chuki hain, mujhay yeh hukum diya gaya hai kay mein tamam jahano kay rab ka tabey farman ho jaon

Woh o hi hai jiss ney tumhen mitti say phir nutfay say phir khoon kay lothray say peda kiya phir tumhen bacha ki soorat mein nikalta hai, phir (tumhen barhata hai kay) tum apni poori qooat ko phonch jao phir boorhay ho jao, tum mein say baaz uss say pehlay hi fot ho jatay hain, (woh tumhen chor deta hai) takay tum muddat moyyen tak phonch jao aur takay tum soch samajh lo
O hi hai jo jilata hai aur maar dalta hai, phir jab woh kissi kaam ka kerna muqarrar kerta hai to ussay sirf yeh kehta hai kay ho jaa pus woh ho jata hai
Kiya tu ney unhen dekha jo Allah ki aayaton mein jhagartay hain, woh kahan pher diye jatay hain
Jin logon ney kitab ko jhutlaya aur ussay bhi jo hum ney apney rasoolon kay sath bheja unhen abhi abhi haqeeqat haal maloom ho jaye gi
Jab kay unn ki gardano mein toq hun gay aur zanjeeren hun gi ghaseetay jayen gay
Kholtay huye pani mein aur phir jahannum ki aag mein jalaye jayen gay
Phir unn say poocha jaye ga kay jinhen tum shareek kertay thay woh kahan hain.
Jo Allah kay siwa thay woh kahen gay kay woh to hum say behak gaye balkay)yeh hum to uss say pehlay kissi ko bhi pukartay hi na thay. Allah Taalaa kafiron ko ussi tarah gumrah kerta hai
Yeh badla hai uss cheez ka jo tum zamin mein na-haq phoolay na samatay thay. Aur (be-ja) itratay phirtay thay
(abb aao) jahannum mein hamesha rehney kay liye (uss kay) darwazon mein dakhil ho jao, kiya hi buri jagah hai takabbur kerney walay ki

Pus aap sabar keren Allah ka wada qata’an sacha hai, unhen hum ney jo waday dey rakhay hain unn mein say kuch hum aap ko dikhayen ya (uss say pehlay) hum aap ko wafat dey den, unn ka lotaya jana to humari hi taraf hai

Yaqeenan hum aap say pehlay bhi boht say rasool bhej chukay hain jin mein say baaz kay (waqiyaat) hum aap ko biyan ker chukay hain aur unn mein say baaz kay (qissay) to hum ney aap ko biyan hi nahi kiye aur kissi rasool ka yeh (maqdoor) na tha kay koi moajza Allah ki ijazat kay baghair laa sakay phir jiss waqt Allah ka hukum ga haq kay sath faisla ker diya jaye ga aur uss jagah ahl baatil khasaray mein reh jayen gay
Allah woh hai jiss ney tumharay liye chopaye peda kiye jin mein say baaz per tum sawar hotay ho aur baaz ko tum khatay ho
Aur bhi tumharay liye unn mein boht say nafa hain aur takay apney seenon mein chupi hui hajaton ko unhi per sawari ker kay tum hasil ker lo aur unn chopayon per aur kashtiyon per sawar kiye jatay ho
Allah tumhen apni nishaniyan dikhata jaraha hai, pus tum Allah ki kun kun nishaniyon kay munkir bantay raho gay

Kiya unhon ney zamin mein chal phir ker apney say pehlon ka anjam nahi dekha? Jo unn say tadaad mein ziyadah thay qooat mein sakht aur zamin mein boht sari yaadgaren chori thin, unn kay kiye kaamon ney unhen kuch bhi faeedah nahi phonchaya
Pus jab bhi unn kay pass unn kay rasool khulli nishaniyan ley ker aaye to yeh apney pass kay ilm per itraney lagay, bil-aakhir jiss cheez ko mazaq mein ura rahey thay woh unn per ulat pari
Humara azab dekhtay hi kehney lagay kay Allah wahid per hum eman laye aur jin jin ko hum uss ka shareek bana rahey thay hum ney unn sab say inkar kiya

Lekin humaray azab ko dekh lenay kay baad unn kay eman ney unhen nafa na diya. Allah ney apna mamool yehi muqarrar ker rakha hai jo uss kay bandon mein barabar chala aa raha hai. Aur uss jagah kafir kharab o khasta huye
